support.notes: Accepted on a physical RC003: the installed macOS app received the microphone-button HID edges and toggled Typeless recording through Control+Option.

transports.notes: The macOS app opens the RC003 HID manager with exclusive access when available, reads report 1, and does not open the device microphone or a BLE GATT connection.

platforms.notes: Accepted on macOS 26.5.2 with an Apple M4 Mac, Typeless 2.1.0, and DJI Mic Mini-DD2942 as Typeless's direct audio input.
This fork does not ship a Windows application.
This fork does not ship a Linux application.
